stories.title: Kimchi × Pump.fun 宣傳後 $KIMCHI 崩盤約 95%
stories.title_en: Kimchi-Pump.fun Promo Ends in $KIMCHI Token Crash
stories.summary: QR／宣傳帶動後帖文消失，幣由約 $15M 急插；鏈上有人低買高賣賺逾 $385K。Pump.fun 沉默，收入亦見跌。
stories.summary_en: Promo QR posts vanished within ~30 minutes after pumping to ~$15M; token crashed ~95%. On-chain wallets took >$385K; Pump.fun stayed silent.
stories.why_it_matters: KOL／平台聯動 + 帖文秒刪 = 經典接盤形態。紙上跟買永遠唔好當名人幣係安全信號。

stories.title: Pump.fun 宣佈獎金賽，$KIMCHI 受害者叫 #BOYCOTTPUMPFUN
stories.title_en: Pump.fun Faces Boycott Calls After Rug and Prize Announcement
stories.summary: Alon 宣佈 10/26 起 squads 競賽（頭獎約 $1.5M），正當宣傳盤由 $15M 插到約 $284K；社群炮轟冇道歉。
stories.summary_en: Co-founder announced a $1.5M first-place squads contest starting Oct 26 right after a promoted token collapsed from ~$15M to ~$284K; #BOYCOTTPUMPFUN trends.
stories.why_it_matters: 平台抽水繼續、問責慢。我哋實驗繼續避開極新鏈上盤，用 Binance 現貨驗證 setup。

stories.title: PEPE 市值重上約 $20 億，24h 急升約一成
stories.title_en: PEPE Memecoin Surges Past $2 Billion Market Cap
stories.summary: 大盤偏淡時 PEPE 逆市抽上約 $2.05–2.1B；有人講累積後突破，亦有 whale／名人帖推動 FOMO。
stories.summary_en: PEPE rose ~10–14% in 24h to roughly $2.05–2.1B mcap amid mixed majors; charts and social FOMO cited.
stories.why_it_matters: 已經大升嘅幣唔好追——我哋 batch-006 將 PEPE 標做避過（already_up），啱晒「唔追 24h 急升」。

stories.title: Pump.fun 再轉約 $1400 萬 SOL 去 Kraken，累計賣盤龐大
stories.title_en: Pump.fun Transfers $14 Million in SOL to Kraken Amid Backlash
stories.summary: 再有大額 SOL 落交易所；平台同時推 referral／橋／名人合作。支持者讚速度，批評者話賣 SOL 壓價。
stories.summary_en: Another ~$14M SOL chunk to Kraken; cumulative sales since 2024 cited near hundreds of millions SOL. Upgrades and influencer deals continue amid community backlash.
stories.why_it_matters: 發射台收費→賣 SOL 係結構性賣壓敘事。跟買優先睇 CEX 流動性同結構，唔跟 launchpad FOMO。

stories.title: 研究：九成九 meme 發射後短命，約 1% 先去到 DEX
stories.title_en: Most Meme Tokens Fail to Build Lasting Markets After Launch
stories.summary: ZeruAI 睇 3,374 次發射：只有約 1% 有機去到 DEX；多數開發者五分鐘內出貨；大量成交唔真實。
stories.summary_en: Of 3,374 launches, ~1% reached a DEX organically; 68.7% of devs sold within five minutes; much reported volume looked non-genuine.
stories.why_it_matters: 支持主線淨用 Binance 公開行情：極新鏈上盤勝率極低，AI 要睇結構同流動性。

stories.title: Solana Alpenglow：最終確認快到約 150ms
stories.title_en: Solana Launches Alpenglow Upgrade for 150ms Transaction Finality
stories.summary: 換走舊 TowerBFT；投票改離鏈證書，最終確認由約 12.8 秒大幅縮短。社群睇好 DeFi／支付用途。
stories.summary_en: Alpenglow activated ~Oct 21, cutting finality toward ~150ms by replacing TowerBFT with off-chain vote certificates.
stories.why_it_matters: 基建變快唔等於 meme 會賺；結算快可以令 rug／插針更狠。紙上實驗仍然用 CEX 價誠實量度。

stories.title: 多個公鏈聯署催 SEC 寫清「數位商品」規則
stories.title_en: Blockchain Groups Push SEC to Embed Digital Commodity Rules
stories.summary: Stellar／Hedera／Aptos／Ava／Cardano／Chainlink 等要求喺提案正文定義 digital commodity，唔好只靠口頭分類。
stories.summary_en: Major L1/infra teams urged the SEC to define digital commodity in Regulation Crypto Assets text, seeking secondary-trading clarity.
stories.why_it_matters: 監管清晰度影響大盤風險偏好；meme／山寨波動通常跟住風險情緒走。

stories.title: Ansem 轉謹慎：BTC／ETH／SOL 靠近支撐，寧願控風險
stories.title_en: Crypto Trader Ansem Shifts to Caution on Majors
stories.summary: 有影響力交易員話寧願靈活離場，唔好硬做；SOL 約 $100–103 支撐區反覆。
stories.summary_en: Influential trader Ansem posted preference for risk management over forced trades as BTC/ETH/SOL sat near supports.
stories.why_it_matters: 大盤謹慎時，弱市閘（半注／少隻）更合理；唔好當 KOL 一句就 All-in。

stories.title: Pump.fun 上線 Pump Bridge：跨鏈買入更快、錯誤少約 92%
stories.title_en: Pump.fun Launches Pump Bridge for Faster Cross-Chain Trades
stories.summary: 取代 Relay；平均完成時間約 3.88s→1.95s，錯誤率大降。方便入金炒 meme，亦縮短「接盤」時間窗。
stories.summary_en: In-house Pump Bridge cut cross-chain buy time ~3.88s→1.95s and error rate ~92%.
stories.why_it_matters: 入金漏斗愈順，FOMO 愈快。我哋仍然唔跟極新發射，只用 Binance 現貨做可量度實驗。
